mapper.select: SELECT MENU_CD, PARENT_MENU_CD, MENU_DEPTH, MENU_NM, ORIGINAL_MENU_NM, SORT_SEQ, USE_YN, DEL_YN, REG_DT, RGTR_NM, MDFCN_DT, MDFR_NM FROM HMPG_MENU WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY MENU_DEPTH, PARENT_MENU_CD, SORT_SEQ, MENU_CD
SELECT MENU_CD, PARENT_MENU_CD, MENU_DEPTH, MENU_NM, ORIGINAL_MENU_NM, SORT_SEQ, USE_YN, DEL_YN, REG_DT, RGTR_NM, MDFCN_DT, MDFR_NM FROM HMPG_MENU WHERE MENU_CD = #{value} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE HMPG_MENU SET MENU_NM = #{menuNm}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, MDFCN_DT = NOW(), MDFR_NM = #{mdtr} WHERE MENU_CD = #{menuCd} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
